metadata.description: Local-first AI short-form video clipper — Whisper transcription, LLM clip scoring, OpenCV face tracking, ffmpeg compositing. No cloud, no subscription.

commit.message:
feat: motion polish pass on landing + app UI (#4)

Apply Emil Kowalski's design-engineering conventions across both surfaces:
shared custom easing tokens, :active press feedback on every pressable
element, hover states gated behind (hover:hover) so taps don't stick on
touch, staggered grid reveals, and stronger ease-out on entrances.

Co-authored-by: clipper <clipper@local>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
chore: keep process/audit docs local, out of the public repo

FINDINGS.md and PLAN.md were this session's audit + staged plan for the public-repo
premiumization work. Useful process artifacts, but they read unmistakably as
AI-agent-generated checklists rather than personal notes - moving them out of the
public repo (kept locally, now gitignored) so the root file listing reads as a normal
project. CLAUDE.md stays; it's now a common, unremarkable convention.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
